# Playwright Test Artifacts

This directory contains all Playwright E2E test artifacts and reports.

## Directory Structure

```
playwright/
├── screenshots/       # Test screenshots (before/after states)
├── reports/          # HTML test reports
├── test-results/     # Test execution artifacts (.last-run.json, traces, etc.)
└── .gitignore        # Excludes generated files from version control
```

## Generated Files

All files in this directory (except `.gitkeep` files and this README) are generated by Playwright test runs and should not be committed to version control.

## Viewing Test Reports

After running tests, view the HTML report with:

```bash
npx playwright show-report playwright/reports
```

## Running Tests

From the dev container:

```bash
podman exec -it autos-prime-ng-frontend-dev bash -c "cd /app && npx playwright test"
```

## Test Locations

Test files are located in:
- `../e2e/` - End-to-end test specifications

## Configuration

Playwright configuration: `../playwright.config.ts`

Key settings:
- **Test directory:** `./e2e`
- **Base URL:** `http://192.168.0.244:4201` (dev server)
- **Browser:** System Chromium (`/usr/bin/chromium-browser`)
- **Output directory:** `playwright/test-results`
- **HTML reports:** `playwright/reports`
